arp.summary: ARP engine: an RX parser feeds frames that update a hashed ARP cache and trigger replies via a TX serializer, while a lookup controller queries the cache and retries broadcast ARP requests with timer and retry counter.

blocks.name: ARP lookup controller
blocks.description: Handles lookup requests, subnet routing, cache queries, retries and responses.

anchors.name: arp_request_operation_reg
anchors.why: Two-state lookup controller: set on cache miss, gates timer, retries and query issuing.

anchors.name: arp_request_valid
anchors.why: Incoming ARP lookup request valid, starts subnet check and cache query.

anchors.name: arp_request_ip
anchors.why: IP address to resolve; compared to gateway/subnet and sent to cache query.

anchors.name: arp_request_ready
anchors.why: Request ready, driven from arp_request_ready_reg when idle.

anchors.name: arp_response_valid
anchors.why: ARP lookup response valid output, from arp_response_valid_reg.

anchors.name: arp_response_mac
anchors.why: Resolved MAC address returned to requester.

anchors.name: arp_response_error
anchors.why: Lookup failed after all retries exhausted.

anchors.name: arp_request_retry_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Counts remaining ARP request retransmissions before error.

anchors.name: arp_request_timer_reg
anchors.why: Retry interval / timeout down-counter triggering retransmit.

anchors.name: gateway_ip
anchors.why: Gateway IP looked up for off-subnet requests.

blocks.name: ARP cache interface

anchors.name: cache_query_request_valid_reg
anchors.why: Cache lookup request valid; also marks a pending query in idle state.

anchors.name: cache_query_request_ip_reg
anchors.why: IP (request or gateway) held for cache query.

anchors.name: cache_query_response_error
anchors.why: Cache miss flag; starts ARP request operation or ends lookup.

anchors.name: cache_query_response_valid
anchors.why: Cache query response valid, gates hit/miss handling.

anchors.name: cache_query_response_mac
anchors.why: MAC from cache hit forwarded to response register.

anchors.name: cache_write_request_valid_reg
anchors.why: Writes sender IP/MAC of received ARP frames into cache.

anchors.name: cache_write_request_mac_reg
anchors.why: Sender MAC latched for cache write.

anchors.name: clear_cache
anchors.why: Command to clear ARP cache contents.

anchors.name: incoming_arp_oper

blocks.name: ARP frame transmit

anchors.why: Outgoing ARP frame valid to TX serializer for replies and requests.

anchors.why: Holds outgoing opcode (request/reply/InARP reply) for TX frame.

anchors.name: outgoing_arp_tpa_reg
anchors.why: Holds target IP of outgoing ARP frame.

anchors.name: outgoing_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Holds destination MAC (broadcast or requester) of outgoing frame.

anchors.why: Local IP compared to target IP to decide replying.

ip_complete_64.summary: Complete 64-bit IP stack: an eth_type classifier routes incoming frames to IP or ARP children, the IP block resolves MACs via the ARP engine, and an arbiter mux merges their outgoing frames.
